paper_title: Leading Axion-Photon Sensitivity with NuSTAR Observations of M82 and M87
notes: Stellar axion production (Primakoff) in M82/M87 with conversion in galactic/cluster magnetic fields. Fiducial 95% upper limit from M82 |g_agamma| < 6.4e-13 GeV^-1 for m_a < ~1e-10 eV (M87 gives 8.4e-13 GeV^-1). Limit is essentially flat for ultralight axions up to ~1e-9 eV; encoded as a horizontal line over the paper's quoted validity range. This is a stellar/astrophysical bound, not a DM haloscope, so no local DM density assumed. | selector: figure_vision over text (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 2, 0, 0.8, 38)) | Vision: Traced the M82 (this work) lower boundary, which is the strongest (lowest) 95% CL limit in Fig 2.
